{"text":"ItemID: 1; Title: M3-0.5 x 12mm (100 PCS) Socket Head Cap Screws, Black Oxide Finish, 12.9 Grade Alloy Steel, Coarse Thread UNC, DIN 912; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My existing metric assortment covers small screws, and I have no immediate need for 100 of this size.
ItemID: 2; Title: KEYXE 8Pcs Screw Eyes, 3.2 Inch Black Eye Hooks Screw Self Tapping Eye, Heavy Duty Eye Bolt for Wood Securing Cables Wire, Hammock Stand, Indoor & Outdoor Use; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these for securing cords and hanging workshop items; they complement my mounting supplies.
ItemID: 3; Title: PLA 3D Printer Filament Bundle, TINMORRY PLA Filament 1.75mm, 250g x 5 Spools, Black+White+Blue+Red+Green, Net Weight 1.25kg; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent projects involve fastening and fabrication, but I have no established need for printer filament.
ItemID: 4; Title: M5-0.8 x 45mm (50 pcs) Hexagon Socket Head Cap Screws, Furniture Screws, Connecting Bolts, 304 Stainless Steel 18/8, Full Thread, Bright Finish, Metric Standard; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These fit my hardware interests, but I would need a project requiring this exact length before buying a bulk pack.
ItemID: 5; Title: #6 x 1" Flat Head Self Drilling Screws, 410 Stainless Steel, Cross Recessed Countersunk Head Self Drilling Screws with Self Tapping Screw Thread, 100 PCS; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have self-tapping screws, so another single-size pack is not a priority right now.
ItemID: 6; Title: Joywayus Pressure Gauge 0 to 30 PSI Brass 1/4" Male NPT Thread Lower Mount, Multiple Function; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I like practical measuring tools, but I do not currently have a pressure-measurement task requiring this range and fitting.
ItemID: 7; Title: [40 Pack] 1/4" x 1-1/4" OD Stainless Steel Fender Washer - Choose Size Metal Flat Washers for Bolts, 18-8 (304) Stainless Steel; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: These would complement my inch-size rivet nuts and help spread mounting loads on thinner material.
ItemID: 8; Title: TECSONAR Tricolor PLA Filament Coextrusion Filament 1kg Triple Color Filament 1.75mm (± 0.03 mm) Compatible w/Most of 3D Printer Silk Gold Silver Copper; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Decorative printing material does not address any current need suggested by my tool and hardware projects.
ItemID: 9; Title: 1/4-20 x 3/4" (30 pcs) Truss Head Machine Screws, 304 Stainless Steel (18-8), Cross Recessed Truss Head Machine Screws, Phillips Drive, Coarse Thread UNC, ANSI B18.6.3T; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The thread matches rivet nuts I bought, making these worth trying for panel fastening after checking the required length.
ItemID: 10; Title: FOLIV 265PCS Black Self Tapping Screws, 8 x 1/2” to 1-1/2” (410) Stainless Steel Modified Truss Head Sheet Metal Screws Assortment Kit, Black Oxide Self Drilling, 6 Different Length Included; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: The varied lengths and broad heads make this a useful option for the sheet-metal fastening work reflected in my recent purchases."}
